recap.headline: LeParth James Hangs Fifty On Acinonyx
recap.subhead: Okongwu and Boozer did the work while Lillard bricked his way to nine points, and the Goons still won the night.

zingers.line: Eshan B promised Frito LAAAAAYS and a title; his team lost the night 6-4 to LeParth James and sits 7th.
Okongwu's 29 points and 4 threes covered for Lillard's 3-for-13, and the manager gets credit for dumb luck.
Went 2-7-2 against theInfamous on a night they led nothing but turnovers, and dropped three spots in the power rankings.
Sabonis grabbed 15 boards and shot 4-for-7, and Gopher Gold still only tied the night 4-5-2 against MONSTARS.
Peyton Watson went 1-for-8 for 4 points and the team still won the night 7-2-2, which says everything about Nova Knicks.
Unluckiest team in the league at minus .264, and a one-category lead over Zero Fox Given won't fix that.
Fears dropped 13 assists and Thug Life still lost the night 4-6-1 to Adam Silver Dez Nuts, while leading the week 8-3.

night: Onyeka Okongwu, LeParth James: 29 PTS, 12 REB, 4 3PTM, 11-17 FG. The best line of the night and the reason Acinonyx never recovered.
Damian Lillard, LeParth James: 9 PTS on 3-13 FG. A starter who took thirteen shots to score nine, and his team won anyway.
Peyton Watson, theInfamous: 4 PTS on 1-8 FG. Shot a perfect 12.5 percent and still got carried to a 7-2-2 night.
Aaron Wiggins went 20 PTS, 4 3PTM, 8-14 FG and is still on the wire. Twelve managers looked at him and chose nothing.
LeParth James won the night 6-4-1 over Acinonyx while Thug Life posted the best record at 4-6-1 against Adam Silver Dez Nuts. MONSTARS were worst at 5-4-2.
